title: Murphy's law in non-abelian Hodge theory
summary: We construct explicit examples of non-integral variations of $\mathbb{Q}$-Hodge structures. Our approach leverages Fenchel--Nielsen-type parameterizations, due to Kabaya and Maskit, of the Teichmüller component of relative character varieties. Additionally, we discuss various Diophantine results concerning the $\mathcal{O}_{K,S}$-integral points of such character varieties, and give a new proof of Beauville's classical theorem on families of elliptic curves.
